title: Out of register
description: Three sets in which register is not held: offset sheets from a blanket wash, two riso works with the second drum left to drift. Edition: 500 copies, 45 gsm newsprint.

title: Same screen
description: One generated set, one photographic set, the same 60 lpi screen. The label states the source; the dot does not. Edition: both sets on one sheet, 80 gsm newsprint.

title: Run of 500
description: First season of the press hall. One set in a run of 500 on 45 gsm newsprint, replaced as sheets yellowed; one set of makeready pulled between jobs.

title: By contact
description: Two photographic sets that stay in contact. Uncut 35 mm rolls on RC paper; fibre prints from 60 lpi film. No enlargement, no crop. Film in the reading room.

title: Cancelled plate
description: Plates and screens after their editions: five copper plates scored, one screen reclaimed after its last pull, each with its final proof. Edition: the cancellation proofs, offset, 100 copies.

title: Dot gain
description: Ink spread on absorbent paper, measured. Nine sheets at rising ink limits, densitometer readings on the wall beside them. Edition at 400 per cent on house newsprint; it will cockle.
